items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/8159fb1e5355094bc7c8297f0e141ab86b9b6f13.png"]
Greetings, survivors!

The wait is over — the latest major Steel Seed update is now available to all players. First of all, we want to thank everyone who participated in the Open Beta and shared feedback with us. Your reports, suggestions, and impressions helped us identify issues, improve existing systems, and further polish the overall experience. Your support continues to play a huge role in the future of Steel Seed.

This update introduces a wide range of improvements across the game, including gameplay balancing, combat refinements, updated mechanics, environmental enhancements, quality-of-life additions, optimization work, and much more. You can find the full Change Log below.

And there’s one more thing — Steel Seed is currently available with a massive 50% discount as part of a Steam Daily Deal. This is your last chance to grab the game at this price before the promotion ends, so if you’ve been waiting to jump in, now is the perfect moment.

For those already exploring the underground facility, we’d love to hear your thoughts on the update. And if you enjoy the game, please consider leaving a Steam review — it helps us tremendously and supports the continued development of Steel Seed.
See you in the shadows.
Fixed an issue that could cause input delays when controlling the game with a controller.
Improved memory cleanup when loading levels.
Fixed an issue where holding a movement direction could allow heavy attacks to be performed repeatedly without a pause.
Added a video to the Help panel with information about armored enemies.
Fixed an issue where, in some cases, the game could crash while moving on elevators in the Biological level.
Redesigned the melee combat system
Added a new Light Attack, increasing the maximum combo chain to five hits
Expanded combat combinations with the ability to integrate unique Heavy Attacks into Light Attack chains
Introduced two new strategic attacks to stun or push enemies away
Replaced the Heavy Combo with a devastating multi-charge Heavy Attack
Push-back functionality removed from Light Attacks and now limited to charged Heavy Attacks and end-of-combo Heavy Attacks
Reworked enemy encounters with updated enemy placement and aggressiveness
Complete rebalance of Zoe’s combat progression
Enemy aggressiveness now scales according to selected difficulty level
Implemented Strafe Mode while locking onto enemies
Added dodge support for Strafe Mode
Perfect Dodge can now be executed during rolls
Adjusted enemy health and stun values according to progression
Enemies now reward different amounts of Glitch depending on game progression
Enemies now correctly switch to search state if Zoe falls outside the map during combat
Introduced armored enemy types
Updated NPC task distribution system to reduce downtime between attacks
Improved attack permission logic for enemies unable to attack
QTE difficulty now scales with selected difficulty level
Reduced the number of active QTE button prompts
Zoe can now knock weakened enemies off ledges using charged Heavy Attacks
Enemies immediately enter combat if Zoe rushes toward them
Ranged enemies now attempt to maintain greater distance from Zoe
Improved retreat pathfinding stability in complex combat scenarios (work in progress)
Enemies may now counterattack after receiving rapid consecutive hits
Improved target prioritization toward Zoe over Koby
Enhanced enemy navigation stability in complex areas
Added Combat Mastery upgrades
Reworked skill dependencies; unlocking skills now reveals their upgrades
Removed Damage+ upgrade and replaced it with Combat Mastery 1 & 2 for existing players
Split Koby Stun into separate Koby Stun and Koby Stun+ upgrades
Updated several Bullet Up, Ammo Up, Energy Up, and Tool challenges
Replaced all time-based challenges with UI-assisted counter challenges
Rebalanced skill costs
Introduced free Battlesuits for Zoe and Koby
Added Blade Skins unlocked through Combat Mastery upgrades
Fixed HDR black rectangle issue affecting Battlesuit previews
Fixed incorrect language display for Skin names in notifications
Fixed unnecessary Health Boost unlock notification
Fixed Logs menu opening before Shamyr completed dialogue
Fixed rare animation issues with Zoe’s legs after landing
Fixed Zoe occasionally becoming stuck in flying mode after respawning
Fixed gliding during Turret stealth kill animations
Fixed Photo Mode activation during cinematic skipping
Fixed stun damage not applying in Old Construction Chamber
Fixed missing bonus damage on certain headshots
Fixed Koby projectiles missing Turrets despite accurate aim
Fixed Power Node scripted sequence retriggering multiple times
Fixed Shield enemy attack interruptions and aggressiveness issues
Fixed enemy pathfinding recalculation loop near Zoe
Fixed rare close-range combat crashes
Fixed rare crashes related to explosive barrels
Fixed squad assignment conflicts that could lead to crashes
Improved slow-motion mode stability
Reduced risk of freezes and crashes after slow motion
Fixed scene transition issues while slow motion was active
Removed missing asset loading errors
Fixed invalid difficulty assignment crash
Improved synchronization between gamepad and keyboard/mouse controls
Added “!” indicators for newly discovered skills, documents, and Battlesuits
Reworked enemy hit reaction animations
Improved placement of Zoe’s blade decals
Enhanced camera guidance during climbing sections
Replaced gamma tuning image with “S4VI” text
Light rework in the Oil Refinery Tower
Added sound feedback for Turret animations

Minor dress-up fixes and enrichments

Minor NavMesh fixes

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/8159fb1e5355094bc7c8297f0e141ab86b9b6f13.png"]
Greetings, survivors, and everyone following the path through the shadows of the underground facility!

We know things have been a little quiet around Steel Seed lately, but behind the scenes, the team has been hard at work preparing the next major update for the game, and we’re finally ready to let you get your hands on it.

Before the update officially goes live, we’d like to invite you to take part in our Open Beta. This is your opportunity to experience upcoming improvements early, explore new gameplay additions, and help us polish the experience together with your feedback.

The upcoming update introduces a wide range of changes and enhancements across the game, including gameplay balancing, combat improvements, updated mechanics, additional environmental details, quality-of-life features, optimization work, and much more. You’ll find the full Change Log below.

We highly encourage everyone to join the Open Beta and share their thoughts with us. Your feedback plays a huge role in helping us refine Steel Seed and deliver the best possible experience for all players. We are especially interested in hearing your impressions regarding the updated localization support and overall gameplay feel.

notes.title: How to Access the Open Beta

items.text: Open your Steam Library
Right-click Steel Seed
Select “Properties” Open the “Betas” tab
Choose “new_patch_public_beta” from the dropdown menu
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/3d6ef3ca1d6756a247f6a605435888fe0dbfc81c.png"]

Steam will then automatically begin downloading the latest beta version of the update. We can’t wait to see how you approach the new changes, improvements, and gameplay additions. Every piece of feedback helps us push Steel Seed further and shape the future of the game together with the community.
Jump in, explore the facility once more, and let us know what you think. Happy testing — and stay hidden in the darkness.

items.text: [img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]
Hello everyone!

Thank you once again for being a part of the Steel Seed journey. Since launch, we’ve been listening closely to your feedback — and this latest update brings a wide range of improvements that reflect your input.

This patch focuses on refining the overall gameplay experience, with particular attention to narrative clarity, onboarding enhancements, and Koby’s functionality. We’ve revised key dialogue across the game to strengthen storytelling, introduced smarter quest indicators to help you navigate the world more intuitively, and implemented a number of quality-of-life updates to both controller and keyboard/mouse inputs.
Additionally, we’ve resolved several community-reported bugs and polished various systems, from checkpoints and collision to lighting and level streaming.
Let’s dive into the details. 👇
The Quest Indicator(s) now moves along the path to the current objective(s), or to the closest S4VI Point when a teleport is required or more efficient.
Extensive revisions to the game's dialogue throughout the entire experience. These changes enhance narrative clarity, character development, and overall immersion.
The counter for challenges requiring killing multiple enemies in stealth without entering combat is now only displayed after killing at least half of the required enemies.
Updated Photo Mode input to not overlap with the new default Koby Flight movement input.
Minor tutorial fixes.
Minor checkpoint fixes.
Minor collision fixes.
Minor level streaming fixes.
Minor dressup fixes.
Minor lighting fixes.
Koby Tool upgrades had no effect on the equipped tool until it was re-selected.
You could skip the post-Shamyr chasing sequence beginning scene if you kept gliding without landing.
The fast travel menu indicator ignored the Lower Vertical Garden S4VI Point.
Impossible to enter the Photo Mode after some scenes.

notes.title: Mouse and Keyboard improvements and fixes

items.text: The Mouse Wheel can now be used to scroll Koby Tools without the need to open the Selection Wheel.
Kamikaze QTEs with keyboard now display arrows instead of WASD, and can be completed using either arrows or WASD.
Clicking Zoe or Koby skin previews may break the next keyboard input.
Clicking a different tab in the game menu may not switch to the selected tab.
Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]
Hello everyone!

First off, an enormous thank you to everyone who’s joined us on this journey through the world of Steel Seed. Your support, passion, and detailed feedback since launch have been invaluable — and we’ve been listening. This update focuses on enhancing the early gameplay experience and refining Koby’s functionality in and out of combat. We’ve also improved onboarding flow, tool usability, and accessibility to ensure a smoother journey through the depths.
Let’s take a look at what’s new. 👇
Koby Tutorial Overhaul: Improved Koby’s shooting and tools introduction for a more intuitive learning curve.
Noise Diverter Upgrade: Now consistently attracts enemies to the point of impact, rather than the shooter’s origin if previously alerted.
Enhanced Glitch Blast Stealth: Enemies will now take longer to trace Glitch Blast origin unless fired directly in their line of sight.
Increased Koby Stun Damage: Koby’s standard shots now apply more stun in Story and Standard difficulties.
Time Overclock Expansion: Can now be used during Koby Flight sequences.
Aerial Aiming: Aiming and slow-time aiming are now available while double-jumping.
Tool Wheel Reordering: Koby’s tool selection wheel now mirrors the order found in the skill menu for better consistency.

Improved Health Tutorial: Players now receive a Health Boost in the first level with a better onboarding experience. This skill is now called Essential Energy and will be automatically applied to existing save games.
Automatic Recovery: Zoe now heals and enemy respawns reset automatically when reaching a S4VI Point.
Checkpoint Enhancements: Added new and more frequent checkpoints for improved flow and accessibility.
Accessibility Option: New setting to disable the Low Health Red Frame effect.
Final Encounter Prompt: Added contextual command tip for the special interaction in the last section of the Robot Assembly area.
Ledge Climb Teleportation: Fixed an issue where pressing jump repeatedly on a corner ledge could teleport Zoe to another ledge.
Audio Pitch Glitch: Resolved a bug where returning to the last checkpoint during slow motion distorted audio pitch until the next slow motion event.
Power Node Navigation: Adjusted level design to improve player guidance.
Tutorial text corrections
Collision polishing
Visual dress-up adjustments
Background music tweaks
Translation consistency improvements
We’ve also released a new patch for PlayStation 5 that resolves issues affecting certain trophies. Thank you for your continued patience and support.
Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44227156/d95d2ef6fbb0378e4dd403f105516714f2d978d6.jpg"]
Hello everyone!

First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been closely listening to your suggestions and analyzing your reports. Today, We’re back with another Steel Seed update – and this one’s all about fine-tuning the combat experience and making your efforts count even more.

With the addition of new Glitch rewards, improvements to combat visibility and UI, as well as a range of bug fixes and quality-of-life enhancements, this patch is designed to make your journey through the depths of Steel Seed smoother, deadlier, and more rewarding than ever.
Let’s dive into what’s new👇
Glitch Rewards Added
Receive Glitch rewards after delivering Shards to S4VI.
Receive Glitch rewards after delivering Encrypted Logs to Shamyr.
Combat Experience Enhancements
Increased Field of View during combat for improved situational awareness.
Reworked enemy UI for easier readability.
Added VFX effects on stunned enemies to better highlight downed targets.
Enemies now deal reduced damage in Standard and Hard difficulties.
Navigation & Gameplay Improvements
Extended discovery area for certain S4VI Points to trigger checkpoints more consistently.
Elevators in the Hive section can now also be used to go back.
Achievements based on subquests now unlock upon completing the corresponding main quest, if not triggered earlier.
Photo Mode Tweaks
Reduced camera aperture when using Portrait lenses for better depth-of-field control.
Fixed: Glitch counter not displaying collected Glitch during Koby Flight.
Fixed: Glitch counter displaying incorrect values after collecting Glitch in Koby Flight.
Fixed: Glitch counter disappearing after using Photo Mode.
Fixed: Piano achievements not unlockable when using a Keyboard.
Fixed: 100% level completion possible without collecting T1F Drones.
Fixed: Some voice-overs remained in default language after switching language and reloading.
Fixed: Occasional crash when equipping Bee Battlesuit for Zoe in the S4VI HUB.
Fixed: Hive elevators not working on second attempt.
Fixed: Hacked enemies in scripted combat either attacking Zoe or not acting at all.
Fixed: Scripted enemy encounter could be skipped by jumping through its trigger.
Various collision fixes.
Various level streaming fixes.
Minor optimization and lighting improvements.
Minor cinematic and dress-up adjustments.
Special thanks to the community for reporting many of these issues. Your support continues to drive our development forward.
For now, you can enjoy Steel Seed at 25% on Steam from today, running all the way through the Steam Summer Sale, ending July 10th!

items.text: Hello everyone!

First of all, a massive thank you to all of you for your continued support, feedback, and passion for Steel Seed. Since launch, we’ve been carefully listening to your suggestions and combing through your reports, and we’re happy to roll out another update that addresses both technical issues and community-requested features.
Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game’s evolution, and today’s patch is another step toward making Steel Seed the best it can be.
Implemented a Field of View Offset setting, now available under the Graphics settings menu.
Ultrawide support improved – wide screens now extend the horizontal view instead of cropping vertically.
Added full support for PlayStation button glyphs, which can be enabled via the Accessibility settings.
Fixed a crash when reloading levels that contain ragdolls.
Fixed a crash occurring after using the rapid scan in certain scenarios.
Fixed the puzzle in the Excavation Node becoming unresponsive after player death.
Corrected the chessboard model visual issue.
Fixed incorrect S4VI Point assignment for a T1F Drone in “Titan’s Core” (previously linked to “The Depth”).
Resolved an issue causing excessive delay between in-game dialogue lines.
Fixed cut-off Russian voice-over lines during certain dialogue sequences.
Applied minor translation fixes across several languages.
Special thanks to the community for highlighting several of the above issues. We’ll continue work on exciting new updates to make the game even better! Stay tuned!
🚀 Join the Adventure!

Haven’t played yet? Now’s the perfect time to dive into Steel Seed! Play as Zoe and her drone Koby as they explore a hostile underground facility. Uncover secrets, survive dangers, search for answers, and humanity’s last hope.
For the latest news and updates, please be sure to follow Steel Seed on ESDigital Games social media channels if you'd like to chat with us and your fellow fans.
We are looking forward to seeing you in the game! Thank you for your support, and happy playing!

items.text: We just launched a hotfix for some of the more requested and more-or-less easy to implement features from our community.

notes.title: Here's what we got for you this time

items.text: Fixed a bug when sometimes it was not possible to attach to a wall run anymore after dying.
Fixed a bug when activating Koby Vision Mode while peeking from a cover blocked Zoe in her pose.
Fixed an issue when DLSS and XeSS were not applied correctly at game launch: changing the temporal upscaling settings and reverting them resulted in a different frame rate.
Low health feedbacks are now more visible
Added tutorial for double jump to help with platforming sections
We'll continue working on improving both this demo and the full release, so your feedback is more than welcome!
Until next time,
Steel Seed Team
